questions.why: *whatever* — «що завгодно, будь-що»: *You can eat whatever you like.*

questions.q: Call me ___ you need help. (any time)
questions.why: *whenever* — «коли завгодно, щоразу коли»: *Call me whenever you need help.*
*Wherever* — «куди б не»: *Wherever I go, she follows me.*
*Whoever* — «хто б не, той хто»: *Whoever did this must apologise.*

questions.q: ___ hard I try, I fail. (no matter how)
questions.why: *However* + прикметник / прислівник — «як би не»: *However hard I try…*

questions.q: "When shall we meet?" — "___." (I do not mind)
questions.why: *Whenever* — «коли завгодно, мені однаково».

questions.q: Take ___ seat you want. (from these seats)
questions.why: *whichever* — будь-який з обмеженого набору: *whichever seat you want*.

questions.q: ___ you do, don't tell her. (що б не)
questions.why: *Whatever you do* — що б ти не робив.

questions.q: You can sit ___ you like. (де завгодно)
questions.why: *wherever you like* — де завгодно.

questions.q: ___ comes first will get a prize. (хто б не)
questions.why: *Whoever comes first* — той, хто прийде першим.

questions.q: ___ tired you are, finish your work. (якою б не)
questions.why: *However tired you are* — яким би втомленим ти не був.

questions.q: Pick ___ colour you like — red or blue.
questions.why: Вибір з двох названих — *whichever* (у розмові й *whatever*).
*Whenever I see him* — щоразу, коли.
*whatever happens* — що б не сталося.

questions.q: ___ much it costs, I'll buy it.
questions.why: *However much it costs* — скільки б не коштувало.
Будь-що з двох названих — *Whichever*.

answer: You can eat whatever you want

*whenever* — коли завгодно.

questions.q: No matter ___ you say, I won't change my mind.
questions.why: *No matter what* — що б не. *No matter whatever* — подвоєння.

questions.q: ___ broke the window must pay for it.
questions.why: *Whoever* — хто б не, той хто.
